pages.title: Choose what can move
pages.text: Open a node’s hologram and double-click an item in the displayed player inventory to set a filter sample. Clear a displayed sample to remove it.$(br2)Material matching allows equivalent materials, such as Silver Ingots from different mods. Damage and item-data matching can be adjusted separately. Check both ends of the transfer.

pages.title: Send useful batches
pages.text: The Output Node’s stack setting is the $(thing)minimum batch$(), from 1 to 64. A setting of 64 waits until a whole stack is available.$(br2)Large batches use less flux per item. Add a Round Robin Node behind an Output Node to rotate batches among eligible destinations.$(br2)If transfers stall, check batch availability, destination space and both filters.
